grammar.summary: 本课学习表华丽修饰的语义场与 as...so 对称句。

points.title: as...so... 对称类比句
points.explanation: As the ship rose, so did the storm. 正如A……B也……。文学化对称结构。

examples.en: As she was beautiful, so was she doomed.
examples.cn: 她美则美矣，命运却注定。

points.title: go down 表沉没的叙事动词
points.explanation: The Vasa went down on her maiden voyage. went down = 沉没；set out on her maiden voyage = 处女航出发。

examples.en: The Vasa met her end in the harbour.
examples.cn: 瓦萨号在港湾里走向了它的末日。
